interface.longDescription: Horology specialist agents for Pipeline items: research, technical assessment, security review, go-to-market, marketing strategy, content planning and visual Stage 4 synthesis artifacts. The supervisor runs synthesis immediately after Stage 3 in the same session, then presents the combined output for founder review. Synthesis supports Python-made charts and optional private Cloudflare Pages viewing when deployment access is configured. Requires separately connected Google Drive, Docs and Sheets, and read-only repository access for technical and security reviews.
